strict_preimage_uniqueness_constraints.description: Formal scaffold for constraints on strict preimage uniqueness in orientation-conditioned reconstruction.
core_principles: Strict uniqueness is a local property contingent on orientation-signature distinguishability.
Global uniqueness is structurally blocked by many-to-one operator aggregation.
Local uniqueness requires membership in the open admissibility window and non-degenerate orientation state.

constraint_classes.name: locally_unique_preimage
constraint_classes.condition: Unique mismatch minimum AND unique orientation signature -(i) within finite CSI domain.
constraint_classes.description: Xi isolates a single admissible history.

constraint_classes.name: orientation_split_preimage
constraint_classes.condition: Metric trace is identical but histories have divergent -(i) signatures.
constraint_classes.description: Xi splits the observable class into multiple unique preimages.

constraint_classes.name: bounded_multi_preimage
constraint_classes.condition: Degenerate orientation signatures across symmetric delta branches.
constraint_classes.description: Xi recovers a finite set of admissible preimages.

constraint_classes.name: global_uniqueness_blocked
constraint_classes.condition: Membership in a saturated recursive loss basin (REB-001) or NavT aggregate class.
constraint_classes.description: Strict uniqueness is formally impossible for global causal history.

constraint_classes.name: projection_collapsed_preimage
constraint_classes.condition: Sub-threshold states map to null state history.
constraint_classes.description: Information lost in projection creates indistinguishable preimages.

constraint_classes.name: boundary_failed_preimage
constraint_classes.condition: States on the epsilon boundary saturation limit.
constraint_classes.description: Singular limit prevents unique preimage isolation.

constraint_classes.name: observable_underdetermined_preimage
constraint_classes.condition: Insufficient metrics to constrain high-dimensional state preimages.
constraint_classes.description: Metric traces form equivalence fibers rather than points.
